shots.intent: 把旧车泄压下沉、叉尖歪斜、泵脚油渍与拖行印这套仓库日常损耗放大成同构图双栏，再让本品出现在解法一侧。

shots.intent: 同一块地坪、同一托位、同一顶光的正俯视双栏，只用叉尖入袋位置与轮迹直歪的肉眼差替代一切操控形容词。

shots.intent: 侧面实景把整机放进装柜与卸货的第一现场，让仓储与物流买家直接代入自己的月台，接住源图集装箱与纸箱那一屏。
高俯角把环氧地坪、水泥地、瓷砖与门槛木桥四块作业面平铺同框，用可见的地面覆盖替代静音耐磨爬坡的口头主张。

shots.intent: 贴到浇铸泵壳、活塞杆、防尘密封圈与复位弹簧上，用可数的铸造面与杆面替代不漏油与进口原件的口头承诺。
把加厚钢板货叉、三角前桥与横梁焊缝拆成两处可核验视窗，讲清承载结构却坚决不写毫米数与钢材牌号。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless matte #FFFFFF studio panels for the packshot and the mechanism screens, alternating with matte #F1F3F5 card fields for the infographic screens, one matte #BFC8D0 band used only as a header or divider strip, and real job surfaces (poured concrete #6E7076, epoxy-coated floor #A7ADB3, glazed tile #DCE1E4, dock timber #8A6A43, corrugated container steel #C2412B and #D89B2A, kraft carton #C8A26B) only on the scene screens; one single field of soft concentric relief arcs in #F1F3F5 is permitted behind the opening hero only; no scenery, no gradient wash, no stock warehouse murals, no gold certificate frames
style.direction: premium warehouse manual material-handling equipment commerce
style.iconSystem: minimal infographic only: monoline thin-line icons in #2D2D2D centred inside rounded #FFFFFF chips on a #BFC8D0 or #F1F3F5 card field, oversized low-contrast numerals behind the proof and step screens, single hairline dividers and hairline leader lines, one short three-segment rule bar in #2D2D2D, #B5122C and #F2B91F under every sub-heading, one slim vertical capsule pill carrying a two-digit step number on #E6E9EC
style.lightingSystem: broad soft top-front key at 5600K with a raking side key from frame-left at 5600K that reads painted-steel grain, full-circumference weld beads, the cast pump body, the polished piston rod, the coil return spring and the moulded handle grip, one slim rim along the handle and the rod so the silhouette separates, firm single contact shadow under forks and wheels, controlled speculars on the polished rod and cast surfaces never blown out; the scene screens keep the same 5600K direction so every shadow inside a frame agrees
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium warehouse manual material-handling ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of primary field #FFFFFF, secondary card field #F1F3F5, accent band #BFC8D0, headline text #2D2D2D, one accent red #B5122C and the machine body yellow #F2B91F; cool-neutral temperature held across every screen; one font family, modern geometric sans-serif, with a heavy condensed weight for Chinese set in 「」; background system of seamless matte #FFFFFF studio panels, seamless matte #F1F3F5 card fields, one #BFC8D0 header or divider band, real epoxy #A7ADB3 and concrete #6E7076 job surfaces only on the scene screens, one soft concentric relief arc field permitted only behind the opening hero, no scenery and no gradient wash; broad soft top-front key at 5600K plus a raking side key from frame-left at 5600K that renders painted-steel grain, weld beads, the cast pump body, the polished piston rod, the coil spring and the moulded grip, one slim rim and a firm single contact shadow under forks and wheels; minimal infographic language only, namely monoline icons inside rounded #FFFFFF chips, oversized low-contrast numerals, hairline dividers and leader lines, one three-segment rule bar in #2D2D2D, #B5122C and #F2B91F, and one slim numbered capsule pill; the product is always the same single walk-behind manual hydraulic pallet truck at stable scale with twin yellow #F2B91F low-profile welded forks, exposed pump and lift cylinder with visible coil return spring, one continuous black #1F2124 D-loop handle with moulded grip and squeeze lever, and red #B5122C PU wheels, never fitted with a canopy, seat, motor, scissor lift or second handle the reference does not show, forks parallel, level horizon and straight verticals kept straight; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched chip styles, no invented specification numbers, no certificates, warranty years, QR codes, membership or store marks, no identifiable faces, no unsafe handling.
noDrift: no mismatched chip or icon styles

no invented specification numbers for load capacity in tonnes or kilograms, fork length, fork width, plate or tine thickness, minimum and maximum lifting height, overall length, turning radius, wheel diameter, pump strokes, steel grade or manganese wording

no certificates, brand-authorisation frames, registration certificates, inspection marks, test reports, ratings, warranty years, customs or import-origin wording, no QR codes, no membership badges, no store marks, no vendor watermark

no identifiable faces and no full bodies; where a person is unavoidable they appear only as anonymous cropped gloved hands or a shoulders-down torso, and never riding the truck, never standing or reaching under a raised load, never towing a loaded truck down a slope, never with a hand near the wheel or pivot pinch points

no unsafe practice of any kind: no elevated stacked loads in the background, no damaged shrink-wrap spilling, no load wider or longer than the pallet being lifted, no fork tips carrying an unsecured drum or box stack
style.presentationRules: the same single walk-behind manual hydraulic pallet truck at stable scale across every screen: twin low-profile yellow #F2B91F welded steel forks on a triangular front chassis, exposed hydraulic pump and lift cylinder with a visible coil return spring at the steer leg, black #1F2124 D-loop steering handle with moulded grip and squeeze lever kept as one continuous upright assembly, red #B5122C PU load wheels at the fork tips and twin front wheels beside the pump, small #9AA6B2 nameplate decals left exactly where the reference places them and never re-lettered; no canopy, no seat, no powered travel unit, no scissor lift, no brake pedal, no extra tine and no second handle is ever added; forks stay parallel and straight, level horizon, verticals kept straight, product never overlapped by props or pallet wrap
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte paper #FFFFFF and #F1F3F5 on the studio and infographic screens, epoxy-coated floor #A7ADB3 and poured concrete #6E7076 with light aggregate on the scene screens, one dock timber board #8A6A43 and one glazed tile panel #DCE1E4 as wheel-surface samples, kraft carton #C8A26B and container corrugation #C2412B behind the loading screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy condensed headline weight for Chinese set in 「」, headline 32-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 14-18pt, one family only, no serif and no handwritten or cartoon faces, no latin kicker line copied from the reference
